name: Oil UI
cost: Free (MIT). A paid Pro version is $9.99 one-time
works_with: Claude Code, Codex and other agents that install skills. DeepSeek Harness has a native plugin
short: A UI design skill that drafts a few clearly different directions, lets you pick one, then refines it against real screenshots.
what: Oil UI is an interface design skill for websites, apps, dashboards and components. It studies the product's peers, sets a tone, builds distinct directions and puts them side by side on a comparison page. After you choose, it checks the result at desktop and mobile sizes from screenshots.
who: People who want an agent to show them several design options to choose from. Redesigning existing projects and usability polish are in the paid Pro version.

steps.title: Install it
steps.text: It works right away with nothing to configure.

steps.title: Describe what you need
steps.text: Share any brand assets, screenshots or existing project you have. Work in progress goes in a `.oil-ui` folder in your project.

steps.title: Pick a direction
steps.text: On the comparison page, click "Select" on the one you like and paste the copied sentence back to your agent.

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Use oil-ui to explore a few design directions for this course booking product and build pages I can preview."

watch: Each use checks ui.oiloil.org for a newer version, at most once every 10 minutes. It uploads nothing from your project. Set `OIL_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to turn it off.
Don't install it alongside Oil UI Pro. The two compete for the same requests.
